## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (no warnings)
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes (`npm run format` fixes it)
- [ ] `npm run coverage` passes (all tests, and the 95 % thresholds)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes (needed when the change is visible in the app)
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and the docs are updated where behaviour changed
